issues.title: Add a greet() helper with tests
issues.description:
Create `greet.py` exposing `greet(name)` that returns `Hello, <name>!`.
Add `test_greet.py` covering the normal case and the empty-name case.
Empty or whitespace-only names must raise ValueError.
Verify with `python3 -m pytest -q` (or unittest if pytest is unavailable).
